en.headline: Police arrest six over HK$14 million agarwood investment scheme
en.dek: Officers raided a Kwun Tong office and warehouse in an operation codenamed Shadow Net after 21 mostly elderly victims reported losses ranging from HK$30,000 to HK$1.9 million.
body: Hong Kong police said on Thursday they had dismantled a cross-border syndicate accused of operating an investment fraud involving agarwood trees, arresting six people aged between 52 and 66 and seizing assets linked to more than HK$14 million.

The Commercial Crime Bureau said it had received reports from 21 victims since September, most of them elderly, who invested in schemes promoted by a local company between 2017 and this year. Individual losses ranged from HK$30,000 to HK$1.9 million. Officers raided the company’s office and warehouse in Kwun Tong as well as residences, recovering about HK$540,000 in cash, electronic devices and suspected agarwood products.

Police said the company had offered at least four investment plans. The earliest sold agarwood trees for HK$10,000 each with a guaranteed monthly return of HK$300, or about 36 per cent annually, plus repayment of principal after three years. When redemptions stalled from 2024, the firm introduced further schemes including a 25 per cent intellectual-property licensing plan, a proprietary cryptocurrency and an automated car-wash investment, which police said were used to delay repayment.

Superintendent Chu Ming-lun of the Commercial Crime Bureau said the mastermind was believed to hold a foreign passport. The Securities and Futures Commission had earlier placed the company on its alert list for suspicious investment products. The arrested persons were suspected of obtaining services by deception or related offences; investigations continue.

zh.headline: 警方搗破沉香樹投資騙局拘捕6人涉款1400萬
zh.dek: 商業罪案調查科展開代號「影網」行動，搜查觀塘辦事處及倉庫，21名受害人多為長者，個別損失由3萬至190萬元。
body: 警方周四表示已搗破一個涉及沉香樹投資的跨國犯罪集團，拘捕6名年齡介乎52至66歲的人士，並檢獲與超過1400萬元投資有關的資產。
商業罪案調查科指，自9月起接獲21名市民報案，受害人大部分為長者，早於2017年起參與一間本地公司推出的投資計劃。個別投資金額由3萬至190萬元不等。警方搜查該公司位於觀塘的辦事處及倉庫，以及被捕人士住所，檢獲約54萬元現金、電子設備及懷疑沉香產品。
警方稱，涉案公司過去幾年至少推出4項投資計劃。最早的是以1萬元購入一棵沉香樹，每月保證獲300元利息，年回報約36%，並承諾3年後全數退回本金。由2024年起部分投資者無法贖回本金或收取利息後，公司再推出知識產權許可計劃、自家虛擬貨幣及自動洗車站投資等，警方指這些安排用以拖延還款。
商業罪案調查科警司朱銘麟表示，相信主腦持外國護照。證監會較早前已將有關公司列入可疑投資產品警示名單。被捕人士涉嫌以欺騙手段逃避法律責任等罪，調查仍在進行。
